notes:
POC objective: validate Redwood Dedicated for low-latency chat and large-batch embedding workloads under realistic mixed traffic. 
- Customer: mid-to-large SaaS with global support chat, heavy peak windows (US morning and EU afternoon).
- Key ask from Head of ML: guarantee p95 generation latency under 200ms for 512-token average response at production concurrency. Quote: "We need predictable tail latency during marketing pushes. Unpredictable slowdowns kill conversions."
- Security: full SSO/SAML integration, KMS for model keys, data residency in US/EU, SOC2 required.
- POC constraints: must run in their VPC with optional air-gapped segment for high-risk test vectors. They prefer L40 compared to A100 for mixed perf/cost profile.
- Pricing sensitivity: wants committed-reserved contract but needs fallback clauses if latency SLOs missed for two consecutive months.
- Internal note: engineering prefers to test both 8x and 16x GPU pool sizes; product requests cost delta calculations tied to observed token/sec.
- Ask from procurement: sample SLA language and credits model for SLO misses.
- Representative prompts captured in test-suite (see POC plan).

poc_plan_summary: 3-week POC: week 1 baseline functional tests (chat + embeddings), week 2 load & soak (72h sustained with step-up phases), week 3 analysis and pricing negotiation. Deliverables: p95/p99 latency report, throughput curves, cost-per-1M-tokens estimate, SLA draft with credit table.
perf_targets: p95 latency <= 180ms for 512-token avg responses at target concurrency
sustained throughput 3.2k requests/min for 1k-token average across pool
concurrency target: support 1200 concurrent user sessions with <10% queuing
cache hit goals: 20% prefix KV cache expected to reduce token cost by ~12%
hardware_plan: Baseline: 8 x NVIDIA L40 (reserved pool). Burst: up to 16 nodes via autoscaling (dedicated capacity). KV cache on local NVMe, per-node batching tuned to 20-40ms target for small requests.
load_test_plan: Step-load with 6 phases: dry-run, ramp to 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%, 125% sustained. Each phase 6h; final soak 72h at 100% with occasional 125% spikes. Use mixed prompt mix: 60% short chats (<=128 tokens), 30% medium responses (256-512 tokens), 10% long (800-1k tokens). Collect token/sec, GPU util, queue times, p50/p95/p99 latencies.
soak_test_criteria: No p95 spikes above SLO > 200ms for more than 5 minutes in a rolling 1h window; <5% error rate; GPU avg util 60-85% (sustained). If failed twice, trigger fallback to burst nodes and notify sales for credits discussion.
representative_prompts: Short-chat: 'Customer: My order is delayed, status? Provide polite next steps and apology.'
Medium: 'Summarize the following support thread (5 emails) into action items and next steps for agent escalation.'
Long: 'Given user product usage logs (700 tokens), generate personalized retention offer and 6 bullet talking points for an agent call.'
Embedding-batch: 'Batch of 200 docs (avg 300 tokens) to embed; target end-to-end throughput for nightly index update.'
pricing_discussion: Customer requests committed monthly nodes with step-down discounts at 12/24 months. Wants service credit table for SLA misses (0.5% credit per 1% SLO breach up to 10%). Proposal provided v1; procurement asked for scenario-based pricing on 8-node vs 16-node reserved plans.
